label: Search question
description: Mathematical question and scope frozen before searching
verification_rule: timestamp precedes the final decision

label: Query ledger
description: Queries services times results and retention decisions
verification_rule: sequence and completeness are checked

label: Candidate matrix
description: Comparison of authority version rights coverage and decisions
verification_rule: every decision has a reason

label: Stopping rule
description: Stopping conditions written before the conclusion
verification_rule: conditions match the ledger

label: Source freeze
description: PID or authoritative URL version locator date and byte witness
verification_rule: version witness can be retrieved again

label: Uncertainty ledger
description: Open questions status basis and actions
verification_rule: status history is not erased during revision

label: Seminar identity
description: Event date time zone role and pathway
verification_rule: personal data are minimized and the event basis is verified

label: Timed notes
description: Observations inferences and verifications with locators
verification_rule: segments can be matched to permitted material

label: Dependency map
description: Connected claims and prerequisites
verification_rule: every node has a locator

label: Question log
description: Questions actions evidence and status
verification_rule: open issues are retained

label: Attendance or supervision evidence
description: Data-minimizing witness for the actual pathway
verification_rule: a verified human attests to the pathway

label: Final notes
description: Notes showing corrections after checking
verification_rule: changes from the initial notes are traceable

label: Access report
description: Surface test method results and accessibility limitations
verification_rule: tested surfaces are distinguished from untested ones

label: Initial artifact
description: Manuscript or product before critique
verification_rule: byte count and hash match

label: Referee report
description: Comments with locators and evidence
verification_rule: referee ID is opaque and scope is stated

label: Author response
description: Response to each comment with action evidence location and status
verification_rule: every comment has a row

label: Disposition table
description: Mapping to accepted partially_accepted rejected_with_reason or unresolved
verification_rule: values come from the controlled vocabulary

label: Revised artifact
description: Manuscript or product after the response
verification_rule: byte count and hash match

label: Before-and-after evidence
description: Exact comparison of changes to claims proofs and limitations
verification_rule: locators for both versions are available

label: Distinctness attestation
description: Minimal statement that two IDs represent two humans and conflicts were checked
verification_rule: identities are not disclosed in the package

label: Remaining issues
description: List of open issues after revision
verification_rule: no item is closed without evidence

label: Defect locator
description: Exact position of the statement or step being audited
verification_rule: locator matches the frozen version

label: Minimal reproducer
description: Smallest argument or computation that tests the defect
verification_rule: can be repeated without hidden access

label: Minimal correction
description: Smallest possible change with proof
verification_rule: claims that do not need changing are preserved

label: Impact audit
description: Dependencies and scope that are affected or still unknown
verification_rule: uncertainty about scope remains visible

label: Independent check
description: Method results scope and limitations of a second human checker
verification_rule: distinctness attestation and checking artifact are available

label: Contribution packet
description: Concise reviewable and nonduplicative artifact
verification_rule: version rights target and validation are complete

label: Rights check
description: Rights of the source contribution and target plus attribution
verification_rule: every component has a rights basis

label: Status ledger
description: Append-only events with status and evidence
verification_rule: every status advancement has evidence

label: Transaction authorization
description: Specific human authorization for one target artifact channel and validity period
verification_rule: all minimum fields are present and remain valid

label: Transmission receipt
description: Witness that a particular artifact version was sent to the target
verification_rule: bytes or identifier match the authorized package

label: Independent local review
description: Independent human report on a real-source package without community transmission
verification_rule: human ID is verified and the local boundary is stated
